'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a female Huanglong NPC dressed in Septimont fashion, found in [[Capitoline Hill]], north from Capitoline Hilltop Resonance Beacon. 
__NOTOC__
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:;'''"Peach"''' Hey there, {{MC|m=dark-haired handsome man|f=beautiful lady}}.
:;'''"Peach"''' You don't look like you're from around here... Mind if I ask you a few questions for a quick interview?
==Dialogue==
:'''"Peach":''' Hey there, traveler! Judging by your outfit, you must know a thing or two about fashion.
:'''"Peach":''' So, do you prefer the Septimont or Huanglong styles?
:{{DIcon}} Haunglong's
::'''"Peach":''' Right, your outfit already gave it away. Indeed, there's something about hometown style. It just feels like home, no matter where you are.
:{{DIcon}} Septimont's
::'''"Peach":''' Oh wow, we've got the same taste! Septimont's designs have that unmistakable beauty, don't they?
::'''"Peach":''' Lightweight, clean-cut, but so full of geometric flair. Always so daring!
:{{DIcon}} Don't like any of them.
::'''"Peach":''' Oh? That's unexpected... Well, it seems that I need to work harder to be the trendsetter.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Not interested, sorry.
{{Dialogue End}}
